prompt: Create a square abstract album-cover style illustration featuring a silhouetted young female electric guitarist standing full body in the exact center, legs apart in a confident rock stance, holding a dark offset electric guitar across her torso. Her face is mostly hidden in shadow, with messy shoulder-length hair, slim proportions, dark fitted clothing, fingerless-glove feeling, and ankle boots. Use a limited Bauhaus-meets-blueprint palette of deep navy, warm ivory, bright turquoise, and muted ochre gold. The background is a distressed geometric composition: one large off-white circular/spiral block behind the figure, one huge turquoise crescent arc sweeping from upper center to right, and one dark navy field framing the edges. Include exactly 3 prominent turquoise circular elements: a large crescent/arc circle section in the upper right, a solid cyan circle left of center near the music staff, and a textured cyan circle on the right with a small ochre wedge. Add exactly 3 turquoise square/rectangular accents: one small square at lower left of the central circle, one larger rectangle near the far lower right edge, and one small square in the upper-right technical grid. Overlay the whole image with fine technical-drawing details: thin white, black, and ochre construction lines, circular arcs, dashed orbit lines, crosshair marks, graph-paper grids, right-angle drafting lines, dots, arrows, and small measurement ticks. Add exactly 3 visible musical staff fragments with notes: one mid-left horizontal staff with a treble clef, one lower-left staff with notes, and one thin staff on the right side crossing behind the guitarist. Make the texture feel screen-printed and worn, with scratched ink, rough paint edges, paper grain, and slight grunge distress. No readable title text, no logos, no watermark. High contrast silhouette, cinematic lighting, modern Japanese AI-art feel, crisp composition suitable for an experimental rock album cover.
